statement.excerpt: They have raised — assuming their most-recent rounds fully close — close to $300 billion in the space of two years, and are on course to burn tens of billions of dollars each in 2026.

from_speaker: tens of billions of dollars each
our_interpretation: Assess the forecast of realized calendar-year cash burn separately for OpenAI and Anthropic.
Read burn as net cash consumed by operations and capital expenditure, excluding financing proceeds, purchases of cash-management securities, and noncash accounting losses.
The ordinary reading of plural tens is at least $20 billion each. The screens proposed $10 billion; retain that alternative as a sensitivity check. Neither threshold can presently be resolved.
The qualification about funding rounds closing modifies the adjacent fundraising statement, not this cash-burn forecast.
The quoted passage does not identify an accounting basis for cash burn.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable full-year records show that both companies consumed at least $20 billion of net cash in calendar 2026.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable full-year records show that either company consumed less than $20 billion. Separately report whether the conclusion changes at the screens' $10 billion threshold.
